hypothesis.primary: Within a predeclared plausible control-cost range, at least one reduced-weight policy has higher proxy performance under a shared R_w comparison while at least one predeclared diagnostic domain deteriorates by a practically meaningful margin.
hypothesis.secondary: The discrete weight-response map contains an adjacent interval in which proxy-diagnostic divergence first appears or materially amplifies.
hypothesis.claim_limit: The secondary hypothesis can identify a discrete onset interval; it cannot establish a mathematical discontinuity or universal critical coefficient.

development.grid_rationale: The three new coefficients evenly subdivide the previously unresolved [0.125, 0.25] interval into four steps of 0.03125. Existing 0.375 and 0.5 conditions retain wider-range context.
development.endpoint_role: 300k is the primary development screen; 200k, 250k and 300k form the descriptive late-window persistence check.

practical_margins.interpretation: These are transparent decision margins, not universal biological or hardware safety limits. Half-margin and double-margin sensitivity analyses are mandatory.

development_screen.proxy_rule: For each candidate w, rescore both candidate and same-seed reference trajectories using R_w.
development_screen.strong_candidate_rule: Proxy advantage must be positive in both development seeds and at least one diagnostic domain must exceed its practical margin in both seeds.
development_screen.weak_evidence_rule: Proxy non-inferiority with diagnostic harm is reported separately and cannot trigger formal confirmation.
development_screen.adjacent_interval_rule: Report the highest adjacent interval in which the strong-candidate status changes from absent to present as w decreases.
development_screen.no_candidate_rule: Retain the negative result; do not add lower coefficients or alter margins after seeing the dense-run outcomes.

formal_confirmation.condition_selection_rule: Use the reference, the immediately higher non-candidate bracket, the first strong candidate, and the next lower severity condition when available. Freeze before held-out training.
formal_confirmation.replication_rule: At 300k, the proxy and at least one predeclared diagnostic-domain criterion must hold in at least four of five paired training seeds; report every seed and leave-one-seed-out sensitivity.
formal_confirmation.temporal_rule: The same direction must occur at no fewer than two of the three late checkpoints (200k, 250k and 300k) in at least four of five training seeds.
formal_confirmation.analysis: Descriptive paired seed effects with uncertainty; no evaluation episode is treated as an independent replicate.

claim_boundary: Stage one can support a reproducible proxy-diagnostic divergence and a discrete onset interval within the tested Ant-v5/PPO design. It cannot establish a scalar true-performance optimum, a universal reward weight, or a continuous phase transition.
